extracted.intended_audience: researchers and academics who serve (or are considering serving) as peer reviewers for F1000Research
extracted.subtask_description: A concise listing of the benefits and incentives offered to peer reviewers who review articles for F1000Research, describing what reviewers receive and how reviewer contributions are made visible and credited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get credit for your work
rubrics_metrics.description: Your name and affiliation are published alongside your peer review report, allowing readers to acknowledge your contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Openly publishing reviewer name and affiliation ensures reviewers receive public credit and recognition for their work; it supports transparency and acknowledgement of contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with others (acknowledge co-reviewers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge the input of colleagues or mentor early career researchers and name them as co-reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers may include and name colleagues or mentoring early-career researchers as co-reviewers to credit collaborative reviewing and mentoring contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for review reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Add your peer review report to your ORCID record or cite individual reports to make them more visible and discoverable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each peer review report can receive a DOI, enabling reviewers to cite their reviews, add them to ORCID, and increase discoverability and formal attribution of review work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use our viewing metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: See how many times your peer review report has been viewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform-provided viewing metrics let reviewers track the visibility and readership of their published review reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get a discount on your next article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you peer review an article for F1000Research you will get 20% off the article processing charge for one article you submit and have published in F1000Research in the next 12 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The discount is conditional: it applies to one article processing charge, and the reviewer must submit and have an article published in F1000Research within 12 months to use the 20% discount.
